amount_pattern_note: Exact match on the raw text: no trimming, comma decimals or case folding. Anything else is UNPARSEABLE_AMOUNT and stays unset.
age_unit_convention: years = amount * multiply / divide. One year = 365.25 days = 8,766 hours; one month = 1/12 year; one week = 7 days. Labels are the FDA source list (ASC D.1, FAQ Q6).
age_plausibility_note: Zero is valid (FAQ Q52: neonates). Negative values and values above 120 years are flagged, kept and not banded; nothing is winsorized or set to zero. FAQ Q52 (2021Q4): the modernized system records unborn patients as age 0 rather than a negative age, so a negative age before 2021Q4 is flagged BELOW_MIN, not reinterpreted.
age_grp_note: age_grp is reported, not derived; it has no numeric bounds and never fills a missing age or band.
age_grp_primary_fallback_note: Owner decision A5 (DQD-056): a separate column age_band_primary_or_group uses the numeric band when age is VALID, otherwise this age_grp mapping. age_band_primary itself never uses age_grp. For sensitivity analyses.
sex_note: Exact codes only. UNK (reported unknown) and NS (Not Specified, listed for GNDR_COD in the 2014Q1 ASC_NTS only) both map to UNKNOWN but keep their own statuses; empty (not reported) and an absent column stay separate states. Unlisted codes are kept and left unset. No imputation and no gender inference.
sex_header_rename_note: Historical quarters before 2014Q3 carry the sex code under the header gndr_cod (README revision history 2014Q3). A row uses gndr_cod only when its sex column is NULL (header absent); sex_source_field records which header was read.
weight_plausibility_note: Zero or negative and above 650 kg are flagged, kept and left out of analysis use; nothing is replaced.
